description: Following-only feed, Reels limits, and no ads, Meta AI, Meta One upsells or tracking for Instagram 454.0.0.54.77.

patches.name: Block ad tracking
patches.description: Hides your advertising ID from Instagram and the Facebook SDK inside it, so they only ever see zeros with ad tracking limited, and stops ad clicks from being registered with Android's ad attribution service for Meta.

patches.name: Block analytics
patches.description: Stops Instagram and Meta's analytics, Falco and performance logging from being stored or uploaded. Covers every app event, screen view, time spent and device report sent to graph.instagram.com and graph.facebook.com logging endpoints.

patches.name: Block crash reports
patches.description: Stops crash, ANR and error reports, startup and debug pings, heap dumps and performance traces from being sent to Meta. They carry device details, memory contents and what you were doing.

patches.name: Block cross-app IDs
patches.description: Stops Instagram from handing its phone ID and install referrer to other Meta apps on the device, such as Facebook and Messenger, which use them to link your accounts and app usage.

patches.name: Block federated learning
patches.description: Stops Papaya, Meta's background jobs that train machine learning models and compute federated analytics on your usage data and upload the results.

patches.name: Block in-app browser tracking
patches.description: Stops the in-app browser from sending the pages you visit, the Meta Pixel hits it intercepts and page fingerprints for link classification to Meta.

patches.name: Block network probes
patches.description: Stops Meta's network measurement probes, which send your local IP addresses, DNS setup, carrier and connection quality to Meta in the background.

patches.name: Following-only feed
patches.description: Makes the home feed show only posts from accounts you follow, newest first. Hold the Home tab to switch it off or on.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI from Direct messages (AI chats, the AI button and ring in the inbox search bar, Ask Meta AI on messages, write with AI, AI stickers, AI summaries), Explore search, post and reel menus, comments, the share sheet and the story editor, and hides the Threads button on your profile.

patches.name: Hide Meta One and subscriptions
patches.description: Removes Meta One, Meta Verified and Instagram Plus upsells: the dashed badge next to your name, the menu and settings entries, promo banners and sheets, and Subscribe buttons on creators you don't subscribe to.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts, stories, reels and explore ads, and suggestion units Instagram inserts between posts.

patches.name: Reels limits
patches.description: Reels only works during set hours and has a watch limit followed by a break. The Reels tab disappears while Reels is locked. Hold the Home tab to see the time left and change the limits.

options.description: Time of day (HH:MM) when Reels becomes available. Starting value, changeable in the app.
Time of day (HH:MM) when Reels turns off. Starting value, changeable in the app.
Minutes of Reels you can watch before a break starts. Starting value, changeable in the app.
Minutes Reels stays locked once the watch limit is used up. Staying away from Reels this long also refills the limit. Starting value, changeable in the app.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes igsh, igshid, utm and similar tracking parameters from links you copy or share, so the people you send them to can't be traced back to you. External links open directly instead of going through Instagram's l.instagram.com click tracker.

patches.name: Strip tracking headers
patches.description: Stops every request to Instagram from carrying X-IG-Nav-Chain, the trail of screens you visited, and X-IG-SALT-IDS, the IDs of the actions you were in the middle of.
